name: Veritasor-Frontend
description: Veritasor web app: on-chain revenue attestation frontend (React + Vite demo). Live: https://veritasor-frontend-opal.vercel.app

paragraphs: Web app for Veritasor, an on-chain revenue attestation protocol. Businesses connect revenue sources, anchor a Merkle root of a reporting period on-chain (Stellar), and share verifiable proof with lenders, investors and partners without exposing raw transactions.
This repository is the frontend only. All figures, accounts and attestations in the UI are mock demo data; sign-in is simulated and no backend is required to browse the app.
features: Marketing landing page explaining the product
Auth screens: login (with MFA challenge/recovery), sign up, forgot password
Business onboarding wizard (business, owner, bank, documents, selfie, review)
Dashboard with metrics, usage meters and attestation trigger flow
Attestation list, schedule calendar and per-attestation detail with proof timeline and sharing
